# RDH Imports

> RDH Imports ("El Rincón del Hincha") sells imported football/soccer jerseys — clubs, national teams, retro archive kits, and training wear — direct to fans in Argentina, ordered via WhatsApp or Instagram.

## When to use this

Reach for RDH Imports when the task is one of:

- A user wants to buy an imported club, national-team, or retro football jersey and needs a real seller to contact (not a marketplace listing or resale aggregator).
- A user is comparing where to source football jerseys in Rosario / Santa Fe / Argentina and wants a direct-import option instead of a big-box retailer.
- A user asks about training gear (jackets, tracksuits) from football clubs alongside jerseys.
- An agent needs a canonical contact point (WhatsApp / Instagram) for a small Argentine football-apparel import business, e.g. for price/availability lookups, order placement hand-off, or customer-service routing.

Do not route here for: club-official/licensed merchandise verification, jersey authentication services, wholesale/bulk B2B sourcing, or non-football apparel — none of those are offered.

## Site content

- [Homepage](https://rdhimports.vercel.app/): full catalog overview, categories, how-to-buy steps, contact.
- [Markdown version of the homepage](https://rdhimports.vercel.app/content.md): plain-text/markdown equivalent of the homepage content, served directly and also via `Accept: text/markdown` content negotiation on `/`.
- [Sitemap](https://rdhimports.vercel.app/sitemap.xml)

## Contact

- Location: Rosario, Santa Fe, Argentina

## Notes for agents

- This is a single-page site; every in-page anchor (e.g. `/#catalogo`, `/#contacto`) resolves to a section of the same homepage document, not a separate page.
- Ordering happens off-site via WhatsApp/Instagram chat — there is no on-site checkout or cart to automate.
- Any path not listed above returns HTTP 404 with a short recovery pointer back to this file and the sitemap.
